{{Top|leg}}
'''Vox''' was a subscriber to, and commenter on, "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]." In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Vox commented on the entry for the [[Seeker AS-M12 message droid|AS-M12-series messenger droid]], relaying information that some of the droids were programmed to hunt down targets and explode. The droids were modified by equipping them with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]], a [[Proximity detonator/Legends|proximit detonator]], and information regarding a target's bio-signature.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Vox commented on [[Class I Defense Droid]] entry, passing on information that the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] had deployed a large number of the units against the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]].<ref name="CDD14">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Vox gave advice on turning [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series medical specialist droids]] into [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] by replacing the medical module with a security chip. Vox reasoned that the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] were cheaper than security models, and that no one would expect a medical droid to be used in such a fashion. A fellow commentator, [[Gunman]], rebutted Vox's idea, citing the fact that a medical droid had poor targeting, no inbuilt weapons and core programming that prevented it from applying lethal force.<ref name="CDD13">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
